sdk.name: STM32CubeF4
sdk.versionPolicy: Pin the complete package release and retain its manifest; do not mix files across revisions.

license.name: SLA0048 with STM32CubeF4 additional terms and component-specific notices

testPlan.description: Enumerate exactly one expected probe and record a SHA-256 hash of its serial number.
Erase the lab board, program the trusted smoke image, and verify flash contents against the image digest.
Reset through the debug probe and observe one clean boot marker before the deadline.
Exchange a nonce over the probe virtual COM port and require an exact echoed response.
Drive the documented lab output into the documented input and check low, high, and edge states.
Stop feeding the watchdog, require a bounded reset, and verify the reset cause after reboot.
